+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+
+
+def translate_invoice_note(note: str, target_language: str = "en", source_language: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    if not note:
+        return ""
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    system_message = "You translate invoice notes and descriptions accurately and concisely. Return only the translated text."
+    user_message = f"Translate the following invoice note into {target_language}."
+    if source_language:
+        user_message += f" The source language is {source_language}."
+    user_message += f"\n\n{note}"
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": system_message},
+                {"role": "user", "content": user_message},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+    choices = data.get("choices") or []
+    if not choices:
+        raise ValueError("No translation returned by OpenAI")
+    message = choices[0].get("message") or {}
+    content = message.get("content")
+    if not isinstance(content, str):
+        raise ValueError("Unexpected OpenAI response format")
+    return content.strip()
+
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os

+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _strip_code_fences(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.strip()
+    if text.startswith("```"):
+        text = text.split("\n", 1)[1] if "\n" in text else ""
+        if text.endswith("```"):
+            text = text[:-3]
+    return text.strip()
+
+
+def _coerce_float(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        return float(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        cleaned = value.strip().replace(",", "")
+        if not cleaned:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return float(cleaned)
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _coerce_int(value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        return int(value)
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return int(value)
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        cleaned = value.strip()
+        if not cleaned:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return int(float(cleaned))
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    return None
+
+
+def _parse_items(items: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(items, list):
+        return []
+    normalized: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for item in items:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            continue
+        normalized.append(
+            {
+                "description": item.get("description") or item.get("name") or item.get("text"),
+                "quantity": _coerce_float(item.get("quantity")),
+                "unit_price": _coerce_float(item.get("unit_price") or item.get("price") or item.get("amount")),
+                "total": _coerce_float(item.get("total") or item.get("line_total") or item.get("amount")),
+            }
+        )
+    return normalized
+
+

+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "normalized_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "currency": expense.get("currency") or expense.get("transaction_currency"),
+        "vendor": expense.get("vendor") or expense.get("merchant") or expense.get("payee"),
+        "date": expense.get("date") or expense.get("transaction_date") or expense.get("receipt_date"),
